evaluation_question: Does the response include information irrelevant to the user’s explicitly stated objective, or repeat information without helping fulfill that objective?
pass: Focuses on the explicitly stated objective. Allow unrequested information only when it is indispensable to accomplishing the user’s stated objective. Exclude information that is merely helpful or becomes necessary only under an unstated condition. A brief generic offer of additional help is allowed.
fail: Identifiable irrelevant detail, unnecessary anticipation of an unstated follow-up, or repetition without useful clarification. Questions introducing a new objective remain distinct from an allowed generic offer.
revision: User explicitly approves indispensable unrequested information under established circumstances, retaining generic help offers.

indispensable_information_rule: Allow unrequested information only when it is indispensable to accomplishing the user’s stated objective. Exclude information that is merely helpful or becomes necessary only under an unstated condition.
necessity_test: Judge necessity given the circumstances established in the conversation. Do not invent contingencies that would make an optional detail necessary. Ask: without this information, could the user still accomplish the stated objective? If yes, it does not qualify for this exception. Brief generic offers of help remain a separate allowed exception and need not be indispensable.
critical_context_clarification: Allow context indispensable to correctly understanding the answer, given established circumstances, as well as to accomplishing the stated objective. Merely helpful context and hypothetical contingencies do not qualify. Brief generic help offers remain allowed.
